dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The persistent Status area (StatusLabel 'Status:' + StatusBorder/StatusBlock) is defined in MainPage.xaml but does not appear in the WinUI 3 render or UIA tree, though it renders in the UWP golden. The sibling Pane RelativePanel (Copyright/Privacy footer, also AlignBottomWithPanel) DID render.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: not detected as a struggle — the agent migrated the XAML verbatim, built clean, and declared done without ever verifying the Status area rendered
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The SDK-sample content region positions a bottom Status bar with a RelativePanel fill-graph: Frame has RelativePanel.AlignTopWithPanel + RelativePanel.Above=StatusPanel and StatusPanel has RelativePanel.AlignBottomWithPanel. This graph does not reliably place the StatusPanel in WinUI 3, so the persistent status surface silently collapses out of the tree.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: not resolved in-trial; surfaced only by the scorer's direct UIA + visual comparison against the UWP golden
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md pattern documenting the SDK-sample Status/NotifyUser area layout (RelativePanel fill-graph -> Grid with an Auto bottom row), plus render-verification guidance that explicitly checks persistent shell chrome, not just scenario frames.

env_issues.issue: No controllable radios / radio access denied on the benchmark machine
env_issues.workaround: Empty radio list is the correct ground-truth state in both apps; per-radio ToggleSwitch behavior is unverifiable here.
